answer: Each new agent identity must solve a small hash puzzle and lock a refundable bond slashed on misbehavior, so spawning becomes gassy and ties up capital. Vote weight scales with bond age and verified output, so a canyon of fresh clones has almost no influence. Each identity signs a challenge with a unique quill-style seed, exposing copy-paste clones, and weights decay so an attacker cannot park a prism of dormant identities for a later raid. Cost of N agents exceeds N times the payout.
